nodes.name: Create Vector3 Attribute
nodes.description: Creates/overwrites a Vector3 attribute from X/Y/Z float bindings (constants or per-element attributes).

nodes.name: Add Floats
nodes.description: Adds two floats.

nodes.name: Add Float Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left + right per element from float bindings.

nodes.name: Add Int Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left + right per element from int bindings.

nodes.name: Add Vector3
nodes.description: Adds two Vector3 values.

nodes.name: Add Vector Attribute
nodes.description: Computes resultAttribute = A + B per element from Vector3 bindings (constant or attribute).

nodes.name: Apply Scalar to Attribute
nodes.description: Multiplies each element's attribute value by a constant scalar factor.

nodes.name: Average Vector3
nodes.description: Computes the component-wise average of a Vector3 value across all elements, returning the result as a scalar Vector3.

output.name: Average
output.description: The component-wise average across all elements

nodes.name: Centroid
nodes.description: Computes the average position (centroid) of all elements. Convenience shortcut — no attribute binding needed.

output.name: Centroid
output.description: The average position across all elements

nodes.name: Clamp Float
nodes.description: Clamps a float between min and max.

nodes.name: Clamp Float Attribute
nodes.description: Clamps a float value between min and max per element.

nodes.name: Clamp Vector3 Attribute
nodes.description: Clamps each component of a Vector3 attribute between min and max bindings per element, updating it in place.

nodes.name: Convert Float To Int Column
nodes.description: Converts a float attribute column to an int attribute column by truncation.

nodes.name: Convert Int To Float Column
nodes.description: Converts an int attribute column to a float attribute column.

nodes.name: Create Vector
nodes.description: Create a vector from floats.

nodes.name: Cross Vector Attribute
nodes.description: Computes resultAttribute = cross(A, B) per element from Vector3 bindings (constant or attribute).

nodes.name: Divide Float Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left / right per element from float bindings (safe divide).

nodes.name: Divide Int Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left / right per element from int bindings (safe divide).

nodes.name: Divide Vector3 Column
nodes.description: Divides Vector3 attribute A by Vector3 binding B per element (safe component-wise divide), updating A in place.

nodes.name: Dot Vector Attribute
nodes.description: Computes resultAttribute = dot(A, B) per element from Vector3 bindings.

nodes.name: Element Index Attribute
nodes.description: Writes the 0-based element index to the result attribute for each row.

nodes.name: Get Vector3 Component Attribute
nodes.description: Extracts one component from a Vector3 binding into a float attribute.

nodes.name: Lerp Float
nodes.description: Linearly interpolates between two floats.

nodes.name: Lerp Vector3 Attribute
nodes.description: Linearly interpolates between Vector3 bindings A and B by factor T per element: result = A + (B - A) * T.

nodes.name: Max Float
nodes.description: Finds the maximum float value across all elements, returning the result as a scalar.

output.name: Max
output.description: The maximum value across all elements

nodes.name: Min Float
nodes.description: Finds the minimum float value across all elements, returning the result as a scalar.

output.name: Min
output.description: The minimum value across all elements

nodes.name: Multiply Floats
nodes.description: Multiplies two floats.

nodes.name: Multiply Float Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left * right per element from float bindings.

nodes.name: Multiply Int By Float
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = source * multiplier per element (int × float => float).

nodes.name: Multiply Int Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left * right per element from int bindings.

nodes.name: Multiply Vector3 By Float
nodes.description: Multiplies a selected Vector3 attribute by a float binding (constant or per-element attribute), updating it in place.

nodes.name: Multiply Vector3 By Vector3
nodes.description: Multiplies a selected Vector3 attribute by a Vector3 binding (constant or per-element attribute), updating it in place.

nodes.name: Normalize Vector3 Attribute
nodes.description: Normalizes a selected Vector3 attribute per element, updating it in place. Vectors with near-zero length become zero.

nodes.name: Poisson Disc
nodes.description: Generates a new ElementSet with positions sampled on the XZ plane using Poisson disc spacing.

nodes.name: Remap Range Attribute
nodes.description: Remaps a float value from [inMin, inMax] to [outMin, outMax] per element.

nodes.name: Scale Vector
nodes.description: Scales a vector by a float.

nodes.name: Scale Vector3
nodes.description: Scales a Vector3 by a float.

nodes.name: Scale Vector3 Attribute
nodes.description: Scales a selected Vector3 attribute by a Vector3 binding (constant or per-element attribute) per component, updating it in place.

nodes.name: Slerp Quaternion Attribute
nodes.description: Spherically interpolates between two quaternion bindings by factor T per element.

nodes.name: Subtract Float Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left - right per element from float bindings.

nodes.name: Subtract Int Values
nodes.description: Writes resultAttribute = left - right per element from int bindings.

nodes.name: Subtract Vector Attribute
nodes.description: Computes resultAttribute = A - B per element from Vector3 bindings (constant or attribute).

nodes.name: Sum Float
nodes.description: Computes the sum of a float value across all elements, returning the result as a scalar.

output.name: Sum
output.description: The total sum across all elements

nodes.name: Sum Vector3
nodes.description: Computes the component-wise sum of a Vector3 value across all elements, returning the result as a scalar Vector3.

output.name: Sum
output.description: The component-wise sum across all elements

nodes.name: Translate Vector
nodes.description: Adds two vectors.

nodes.name: Vector3 Attribute Magnitude
nodes.description: Computes the magnitude (length) of a Vector3 binding per element, writing the result to a float attribute.

nodes.name: Evaluate Curve
nodes.description: Samples an AnimationCurve at time t and returns the curve value.

nodes.name: Evaluate Curve on ElementSet
nodes.description: Evaluates a single AnimationCurve for each element, using a selected float attribute as the time input.

nodes.name: Expand Per Element
nodes.description: Replicates each input element repeatCount times and writes source/local index attributes.

nodes.name: Closest Element
nodes.description: Finds the nearest target position for each query position.

nodes.name: Sample From Surface
nodes.description: Samples points uniformly on triangulated surfaces.

nodes.name: Sample From Surface Grid
nodes.description: Samples points on triangulated surfaces using a deterministic global projected grid pattern.

nodes.name: Snap To Closest Position
nodes.description: Moves query positions to their nearest target positions.

nodes.name: Triangulate Points
nodes.description: Triangulates ordered points and emits one row per triangle index entry.

nodes.name: Apply Rotations
nodes.description: Ensures the per-element rotation attribute column exists.

nodes.name: Attract Points To Position
nodes.description: Moves each point toward a target position using distance falloff.

nodes.name: Distance To Point
nodes.description: Computes per-element distance from position to a target point and writes it to a float attribute.

nodes.name: Distribute Points In Grid
nodes.description: Expands each input element into points distributed in a 2D grid.

nodes.name: Distribute Points On Line
nodes.description: Writes per-element positions distributed along a line segment.

nodes.name: Poisson Disc Per Element
nodes.description: Expands each input element into a Poisson disc cluster on the XZ plane and writes source/local index attributes.

nodes.name: Randomize Rotation
nodes.description: Writes random per-element rotations.

nodes.name: Sample Points In Annulus
nodes.description: Generates points uniformly over an annulus on the XZ plane.

nodes.name: Sample Points In Annulus Per Element
nodes.description: Expands each input element into a uniform annulus cluster on the XZ plane.

nodes.name: Sample Points In Box
nodes.description: Generates points uniformly inside an axis-aligned box.

nodes.name: Sample Points In Disc
nodes.description: Generates points uniformly over a disc on the XZ plane.

nodes.name: Sample Points In Disc Per Element
nodes.description: Expands each input element into a uniform disc cluster on the XZ plane.

nodes.name: Sample Points In Sphere
nodes.description: Generates points uniformly inside a sphere volume.

nodes.name: Sample Points In Sphere Per Element
nodes.description: Expands each input element into a uniform sphere volume cluster.

nodes.name: Sample Points On Sphere
nodes.description: Generates points uniformly on the surface of a sphere.

nodes.name: Build Spline From Strands
nodes.description: Builds a spline from rows that share the same strand id and are ordered by step index.

nodes.name: Distance To Spline
nodes.description: For each element, computes the distance to the nearest point on a spline and writes result attributes.

nodes.name: Distribute Points On Spline
nodes.description: Expands each input element into points sampled on a spline.

nodes.name: Distribute Points On Spline By Distance
nodes.description: Expands each input element into points sampled every fixed world-space distance along a spline.

nodes.name: Grow Strands
nodes.description: Expands each seed row into an ordered strand influenced by gravity and nearby colliders.

nodes.name: Sample Spline
nodes.description: Samples a position on a spline at normalized t in [0..1].

nodes.name: Sample Spline Corners
nodes.description: Samples points where the spline changes direction sharply. Threshold is an angle in degrees.

nodes.name: Sample Spline Frame
nodes.description: Samples position, tangent, and normal on a spline at normalized t in [0..1].

nodes.name: Slide Direction On Surface
nodes.description: Projects a preferred direction onto a contacted surface and writes the slid direction.

nodes.name: Create Elements
nodes.description: Creates a new ElementSet with the requested number of elements.

nodes.name: Create Primitive (Generator)
nodes.description: Creates a new element set and assigns one primitive per generated element.

nodes.name: Pick Weighted (Generator)
nodes.description: Creates a new element set with one weighted prefab per generated element.

nodes.name: Sample Weighted (Generator)
nodes.description: Creates a new element set from a weighted prefab sample.

nodes.name: Perlin Noise 2D
nodes.description: Samples 2D Perlin noise at each element's position and writes the result to a float attribute.

nodes.name: Perlin Noise 3D
nodes.description: Samples 3D Perlin noise at each element's position and writes the result to a float attribute.

nodes.name: Spawn Prefab (Generator)
nodes.description: Creates a new element set and assigns the same prefab to each element.

nodes.name: Random Bool
nodes.description: Generates a deterministic random bool from id and seed.

nodes.name: Random Float
nodes.description: Generates a deterministic random float from id and seed.

nodes.name: Random Int
nodes.description: Generates a deterministic random int from id and seed.

nodes.name: Random Rotation
nodes.description: Generates a deterministic random rotation from id and seed.

nodes.name: Random Vector3
nodes.description: Generates a deterministic random Vector3 from id and seed.

nodes.name: Set Random Bool Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a deterministic random bool per element using id, falling back to row index.

nodes.name: Set Random Float Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a deterministic random float per element using id, falling back to row index.

nodes.name: Set Random Int Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a random int per element row to the selected attribute.

nodes.name: Set Random Rotation Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a deterministic random rotation per element using id, falling back to row index.

nodes.name: Set Random Vector3 Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a deterministic random Vector3 per element using id, falling back to row index.

nodes.name: Draw Instanced Indirect
nodes.description: Marks elements to be rendered as GPU-instanced-indirect draw calls (compute-buffer backed) using the assigned mesh and material.

nodes.name: Draw Instanced
nodes.description: Marks elements to be rendered as GPU-instanced draw calls using the assigned mesh and material.

nodes.name: Compute bounds
nodes.description: Computes the bounds of the prefabs into the ElementSet.

nodes.name: Spawn Prefab
nodes.description: Writes a prefab reference into each element.

nodes.name: Assign Parent Element
nodes.description: Appends the parent element and assigns it as parent for all input elements.

nodes.name: Create Parent Element
nodes.description: Creates a single-element set that can be used as a parent object.

nodes.name: Create Primitive
nodes.description: Writes primitive type and default transform attributes into each element.

nodes.name: Jitter Positions
nodes.description: Offsets per-element positions by a deterministic random Vector3 range.

nodes.name: Jitter Rotation
nodes.description: Applies a deterministic random Euler rotation range to each element.

nodes.name: Jitter Scale
nodes.description: Multiplies per-element scale by a deterministic random Vector3 range.

nodes.name: Pick Weighted
nodes.description: Writes one weighted prefab per element.

nodes.name: Rotate
nodes.description: Rotates per-element rotations by Euler angles from a constant vector or a bound attribute.

nodes.name: Sample Weighted
nodes.description: Writes one weighted prefab per element from a sampled batch.

nodes.name: Translate
nodes.description: Translates per-element positions by a vector.

nodes.name: Closest Point On Collider World
nodes.description: Finds the closest point on the live collider world for each row and writes surface metadata.

nodes.name: Compute Slope Mask
nodes.description: Evaluates a per-row surface normal, writes a boolean slope mask, and optionally writes slope cosine, slope angle, and soft-falloff probability.

nodes.name: Project Positions
nodes.description: Casts a ray from each element's position attribute in the given direction and writes the hit point back into the position attribute. Useful for snapping elements to terrain or geometry. When no hit is found, the element position is either kept as-is or zeroed depending on 'keepOnMiss'. An optional start offset moves the ray origin along the *opposite* of the cast direction so that elements sitting on a surface are not immediately clipped by it.

inputs.name: Elements
inputs.description: Input ElementSet — must have a 'position' attribute

inputs.name: Direction
inputs.description: Projection direction — normalised automatically (e.g. (0,-1,0) to project downward)

inputs.name: Start Offset
inputs.description: Distance to pull the ray origin back along the opposite of Direction before casting. Use a positive value to ensure elements resting on a surface still get a hit.

inputs.name: Keep On Miss
inputs.description: When true, elements that produce no hit keep their original position. When false, their position is set to zero.

nodes.name: Raycast
nodes.description: Casts a ray into the physics world and returns the hit point.

nodes.name: Raycast Scene Details
nodes.description: Evaluates one ray per row and writes hit state, hit point, hit normal, and hit distance attributes.

nodes.name: Distance Between Elements
nodes.description: For each element in queries, finds the nearest target element and writes the distance to the distanceAttribute. Optionally clamped by maxDistance.

nodes.name: Point In Closed Spline
nodes.description: Tests whether each element's position falls inside a closed spline boundary (horizontal XZ plane projection). Writes a bool attribute.

nodes.name: Look At Direction
nodes.description: Orients each element to face the specified direction. Uses the world up vector as the default up reference.

nodes.name: Look At Point
nodes.description: Orients each element to face a target point by computing the direction from its position to the target.

nodes.name: Count Collection
nodes.description: Returns the number of elements in an array.

nodes.name: Compare
nodes.description: Compares a numeric attribute against a value and writes a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Compare Attributes
nodes.description: Compares two numeric attributes on each row and writes a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Deduplicate Elements
nodes.description: Removes duplicate elements based on an identity attribute, preserving the first occurrence of each unique value.

inputs.name: Identity Attribute
inputs.description: Attribute name used to detect duplicates

nodes.name: Filter
nodes.description: Filters elements where a numeric attribute satisfies a comparison against a value.

nodes.name: Interleave ElementSets
nodes.description: Alternates rows from two ElementSets (A0, B0, A1, B1, ...), producing a new combined one.

nodes.name: Merge ElementSets
nodes.description: Creates a new ElementSet containing all rows from A followed by all rows from B.

nodes.name: Probabilistic Cull
nodes.description: Keeps each row with a deterministic per-element probability.

nodes.name: Rarefy Distance Cull
nodes.description: Removes elements that are too close to each other, keeping only those that are at least minDistance apart.

output.name: Result
output.description: ElementSet with elements spaced at least minDistance apart

nodes.name: Set Bool Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a bool attribute from a bool binding, optionally gated by a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Set Float Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a float attribute from a float binding, optionally gated by a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Set Int Attribute
nodes.description: Writes an int attribute from an int binding, optionally gated by a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Set Quaternion Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a Quaternion attribute from a Quaternion binding, optionally gated by a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Set String Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a string attribute from a string binding, optionally gated by a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Set Vector3 Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a Vector3 attribute from a Vector3 binding, optionally gated by a boolean mask attribute.

nodes.name: Shuffle Elements
nodes.description: Returns all rows in a deterministic random order using id, falling back to row index.

nodes.name: Skip N
nodes.description: Skips the first N elements from the ElementSet, producing a new one with the remaining elements.

output.name: Result
output.description: ElementSet with elements after skipping N

nodes.name: Split By Bool Attribute
nodes.description: Returns elements where a boolean attribute matches Keep Value. Use two nodes (true/false) to split both branches.

inputs.name: Attribute
inputs.description: Boolean attribute name used as split mask

inputs.name: Keep Value
inputs.description: Rows whose attribute equals this value are kept

nodes.name: Take First N
nodes.description: Takes the first N elements from the ElementSet, producing a new one.

output.name: Result
output.description: ElementSet with the first N elements

nodes.name: Take Random Subset
nodes.description: Returns up to count rows chosen without replacement using deterministic random order.

nodes.name: Pick Weighted Boolean
nodes.description: Picks a single boolean from a weighted list.

nodes.name: Pick Weighted Float
nodes.description: Picks a single float from a weighted list.

nodes.name: Pick Weighted Integer
nodes.description: Picks a single integer from a weighted list.

nodes.name: Pick Weighted String
nodes.description: Picks a single string from a weighted list.

nodes.name: Pick Weighted Vector3
nodes.description: Picks a single Vector3 from a weighted list.
